verdict.rationale: First-party docs state Hoppscotch Community Edition is free, open-source, and MIT-licensed, and the public GitHub repository (hoppscotch/hoppscotch) plus community remarks corroborate that the source is readable. A community comment calls it 'open core', meaning Enterprise Edition features sit outside the open codebase; this limits scope but does not contradict the MIT-licensed CE source. Missing for 10: open source availability for Enterprise Edition features (open-core split), and direct evidence of the repository's LICENSE file contents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
